parent_boundary: JANUS-FC_local reuses an exact residual Boolean judgement but does not automatically produce one context-independent reusable reason.
question: Can a reusable cache reason be discovered as an exact context projection without enumerating all clauses or hiding SAT inside the finder?

exact_lemmas.name: OR Context Reason Lemma
exact_lemmas.statement: For a pure OR cone with n distinct boundary leaves and output fixed true, the unique prime boundary implicate is the width-n disjunction of all leaves, and cone replay discovers it in O(n).

exact_lemmas.name: Parity Clause Projection Lemma
exact_lemmas.statement: For n-bit parity fixed to b, every prime CNF implicate has width n and the exact clause projection contains 2^(n-1) clauses, while one GF(2) equation suffices.

located_bottleneck.name: TRACTABLE_PROJECTION_DISCOVERY
located_bottleneck.definition: Discover, construct and certify an exact context projection in a representation that is polynomial-size and supports polynomial emptiness, conjunction, elimination and witness recovery.
located_bottleneck.why_compactness_is_insufficient: Every source 3-CNF has a linear mixed-gate circuit, so a compact circuit projection always exists, but deciding that compact projection is general Circuit-SAT/SAT.

next_target: Find polynomially recognizable structural invariants of mixed nonlinear cones that guarantee a tractable exact projection while rejecting arbitrary 3-CNF circuit embeddings.
claim_boundary: C027 does not prove P=NP, P!=NP, or a lower bound against all algorithms. It isolates tractable projection discovery as the next bottleneck.
